up: Retrieve the molecule ChEMBL ID (chembl_id from molecule_dictionary), preferred name (pref_name), maximum phase (max_phase), molecule type (molecule_type), and canonical SMILES (canonical_smiles) for all compounds reported in the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL1135903'. Join the docs table (filtered by chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1135903') to compound_records, then to molecule_dictionary and compound_structures. Return all matching rows without any row limit.
sql: SELECT DISTINCT md.chembl_id AS chembl_id, md.pref_name AS name, md.max_phase AS maximum_phase, md.molecule_type AS type, cs.canonical_smiles AS SMILES FROM docs d JOIN compound_records cr ON d.doc_id = cr.doc_id JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON cr.molregno = md.molregno JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno WHERE d.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1135903'
